rationale: The short thesis remains intact — price sits well below session VWAP ($32.29) and 5-min VWAP ($30.67) with pronounced relative weakness versus SPY (+0.89%), and the latest volume burst failed to break $30.42–30.43 resistance, stalling at $30.39.
